cards.reporter_found: Jaguars wide receiver Jakobi Meyers got banged-up in last week's joint practice on Wednesday, leading to him wearing medical equipment on his right hand while on the sidelines during Friday's preseason game. Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Friday that, "We will have to see.
cards.public_evidence_summary: Jakobi Meyers got banged up during joint practice and was wearing medical protection on his right hand Friday.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: This is not panic time, but we are absolutely keeping an eye on it. There is no diagnosis or timetable yet, so guessing would be pointless. Meyers’ next practice update should tell us whether this was a minor August issue or something more.
cards.author: John Shipley

cards.reporter_found: The Chargers had several starters return to practice in some capacity on Saturday. Left tackle Rashawn Slater, wide receivers Tre' Harris and Quentin Johnston, cornerbacks Tarheeb Still and Donte Jackson all were on the field on Saturday
cards.public_evidence_summary: Tre Harris was back on the field Saturday as several Chargers starters returned to practice.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: This is good news. It is not a full green light just yet. We need to learn how much work Harris handled and whether he can put together consecutive practices. For now, though, he is moving in the right direction.
cards.author: Thomas Martinez

cards.reporter_found: Without two of the top receivers, Christian Watson and Matthew Golden played 11 snaps apiece. Watson caught two passes for 19 yards and Golden caught one pass for 19 yards.
cards.public_evidence_summary: Matthew Golden played 11 snaps against Denver and turned his only catch into a 19-yard gain.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Do not lose your mind over one preseason catch, but do not ignore the snap count either. Golden gave us a small but useful piece of information. Now we need to see more routes, first-team reps and consistent usage before calling this a real role trend.
cards.author: Bill Huber

cards.reporter_found: Elsewhere, Jack Strand still did not receive team work, but he is expected to play half of Saturday’s preseason game. Chris Blair received most of Jahan Dotson’s first-team snaps during red-zone work, giving him another opportunity to make his case for a roster spot.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: The opportunity is encouraging, but one practice does not establish that Blair has passed Dotson or earned a regular-season role.
cards.author: Darius Hayes
cards.public_evidence_summary: Blair received most of Jahan Dotson's first-team red-zone snaps during one joint practice.

cards.reporter_found: Mack Hollins has regularly run routes and contributed during two-minute drills throughout Patriots training camp, regardless of which offensive unit was on the field.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Hollins has repeatedly participated in two-minute drills, but the work has come across multiple offensive units. The report does not establish first-team usage, target volume or a defined regular-season role, so his projection remains unchanged.
cards.author: Ethan Hurwitz
cards.public_evidence_summary: Hollins has regularly participated in two-minute drills with multiple Patriots offensive units.

cards.reporter_found: The Eagles officially listed Makai Lemon as a non-participant with a hamstring injury. Although he was not in uniform, he was observed taking part in some receiver drills.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Lemon's non-participant designation is a negative availability signal, although his receiver-drill work shows that he was not completely inactive. The evidence does not establish when he will resume full practice work, so this does not change his projection.
cards.author: Jimmy Kempski
cards.public_evidence_summary: Lemon was officially listed as a non-participant with a hamstring issue but still completed some receiver drills.

cards.reporter_found: DeVonta Smith returned to practice in a limited capacity Thursday. The Eagles listed him as limited with a hamstring injury. A day earlier, he participated in individual drills but did not take part in 11-on-11 work.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Smith's return is a positive step for his availability, but limited practice work does not establish that he is ready for full team periods or game action. No timetable was reported, so this does not change his projection.
cards.author: Jimmy Kempski
cards.public_evidence_summary: Smith returned to limited practice work after previously sitting out 11-on-11 periods with a hamstring issue.
Pierce remains sidelined, although Shane Steichen said he expects him to return soon.
cards.reporter_found: When it comes to other Colts dealing with injuries, Alec Pierce remains sidelined, but Steichen explained after practice that he thinks the star wideout will return in the near future after witnessing him have a promising workout on Tuesday.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Steichen's expectation reduces concern about an extended absence, but Pierce has not returned to practice and no firm timetable was provided. His projection remains unchanged.
cards.author: Noah Compton

cards.reporter_found: Sam LaPorta did not participate in practice. The report did not provide a reason for his absence.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: LaPorta's absence is worth noting, but one unexplained missed practice does not establish an injury or a continuing availability concern. No timetable or additional context was reported, so this does not change his projection.
cards.author: John Maakaron
cards.public_evidence_summary: LaPorta missed one practice, and no reason for his absence was reported.
